name: arbeitsagentur-mcp
description: Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

platform_mcp_arbeitsagentur_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ARBEITSAGENTUR_API_KEY
platform_mcp_arbeitsagentur_api_key.description: The fixed public client id from https://jobsuche.api.bund.dev/ ('X-API-Key ist die clientId jobboerse-jobsuche'): set PLATFORM_MCP_ARBEITSAGENTUR_API_KEY=jobboerse-jobsuche. No registration exists; the BA publishes no developer terms of its own.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Bundesagentur für Arbeit job search (was = job-title free text, wo = place free text, page from 1, size = results per page). The OpenAPI's JobSearchResponse schema (stellenangebote[]/titel/arbeitgeber/refnr/arbeitsort) describes the /pc/v4/app/jobs variant, which answered 403 on 2026-09-24; the /pc/v6/jobs response read that day carries ergebnisliste[] with stellenangebotsTitel, firma, referenznummer (the docs: 'in /pc/v6/jobs die referenznummer'), stellenlokationen[].adresse, datumErsteVeroeffentlichung and gehaltsspanneVon/Bis (annual EUR when verguetungsangabe is JAHRESGEHALT). No posting URL or description is in the search hit; call get_posting. No published rate limit.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Job details by encryptedJobCode: the docs define it as base64(refnr) ('Base64-kodierter Wert der refnr aus der Jobsuche'), so pass the search hit's referenznummer base64-encoded as id (e.g. 10001-1002716922-S -> MTAwMDEtMTAwMjcxNjkyMi1T). The mapped id is the plain referenznummer; description is the posting text (Markdown-like), arbeitgeberKundennummerHash (logo lookup) stays in raw.
